stemMarkdown: In a 800 m race, A beats B by 15 m. Find the ratio of A's speed to B's speed, expressed as a decimal. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: When A finishes 800 m, B has run only $800 - 15 = 785$ m in the same time. Since the times are equal, the speeds are in the ratio of the distances: $\dfrac{800}{785} = 1.0191$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equal time is the hinge — it is what lets you compare distances directly as speeds.
